summary.zhHans: 在 Rusty Lake 一座小岛的废弃小屋里，钓鱼与室内探索逐渐把玩家引向更不安的发现。作品与 Seasons 形成直接联动：先前获得的知识能够改变这里的命运与结局。
summary.en: Inside an abandoned cabin on a small island at Rusty Lake, fishing and exploration lead to increasingly unsettling discoveries. The game directly connects to Seasons: knowledge carried from the earlier game can change the fate and outcome here.
